amendments.normalized_body: Pre-existing test failure must be fixed: `step_hours_leaves_state_untouched_when_clamps_precede_a_validation_error` in crates/tank_core/tests/validation.rs fails because the engine recomputes habitat registry `light_exposure` values before invariant validation runs. When validation rejects the state (e.g., invalid `shrimp_assimilation_efficiency`), the returned state has been partially mutated (light_exposure values differ by 2x from the clone taken before `step_hours`). The engine should either snapshot state before any mutation and restore on validation failure, or defer habitat registry recomputation until after validation passes.

The `check_strictly_increasing` helper in crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs:398-409 only reports the upper field name and value in its error. When the invariant fires (e.g., `optimal_temp_min_c >= optimal_temp_max_c`), the error says `InvariantViolation { field: "shrimp_params.optimal_temp_max_c", value: X }` without mentioning the lower bound that caused the conflict. Consider including both field names or a more descriptive message to aid debugging.
